simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נָכֶה (H5223) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נָכֶה (nâkeh) means smitten , i.e. (literally) maimed, or (figuratively) dejected First listed occurrence: 2Sam 4 4.

definitions.full: H5223. nakeh [ נָכֵה ] adjective smitten, stricken (compare [ נָכָא ]); — only construct: רַגְלַיִם נְכֵה 2Sam 4:4 ; 9:3 crippled of feet ; נְכֵהרֿוּחַ Isa 66:2 contrite of spirit (+ עָנִי ).
